title: Reproduce and Resolve Core Default Gate Timeout
stopConditions: Project Control cannot identify the Core Work path, Checklist target, and Evidence target before editing Core.
The Core default npm run check result remains failing after the lane or only isolated reruns are available.
A timeout-only workaround is proposed without reproducing or classifying the root cause.

summary: Investigate the textBlockUnifiedLayoutTextStyleSourceV1 timeout under the default Core gate, make only root-cause-backed Core changes, and register the resulting evidence separately from compatibility promotion.
